description: This file contains a report implementation for employee leave balance in an ERP system, including functions for data retrieval, processing, and chart generation.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the leave balance report.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and processes leave data for employees based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds query conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_department_leave_approver_map
methods.description: Fetches a mapping of departments to their leave approvers.

methods.name: get_allocated_and_expired_leaves
methods.description: Calculates allocated and expired leaves for an employee within a date range.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for leave balance chart visualization.

methods.name: get_dataset_for_chart
methods.description: Generates dataset entries for charting based on employee leave balances.
